thread:
marta: heads-up — CI red on feature/localize-strings after merging main into the branch. failing unit is i18n/format_test::test_plurals. anyone free for a quick triage? :wave: build: https://ci.internal/redwood/boards/2345/builds/9876
ci-bot: build 9876 failed on shard 7. summary:
```
FAILED tests/i18n/format_test.py::test_plurals - AssertionError: '2' != '2 items'
E   AssertionError: Expected pluralized string to include count suffix
```
diego: can you repro locally? try `pytest tests/i18n/format_test.py::test_plurals -q`
alex: can't repro locally either — on my machine it passes. logs show the failing output was just "2" instead of "2 items", feels like a locale or formatting config difference. maybe CI container missing an intl lib or locale set to C
priya: can we just rerun the shard to rule out flake? if it fails again we should bisect. @sam can you kick off a rerun for shard 7?
sam: rerun queued for build 9876 (shard 7). also, @marta did this branch get a recent merge from chef/intl-change? that one touched pluralization helper
marta: yes merged main yesterday, main pulled in chef/intl-change (sha: a1b2c3d). branch is at f9e8d7c. i can paste git range if we need to bisect
priya: if rerun flakes again, let's bisect between a1b2c3d..f9e8d7c and find the commit that regressed tests. bisect steps: `git bisect start f9e8d7c a1b2c3d` then run the test command.
sam: rerun finished — still failing on the same assertion. not a flake.
diego: ok i'll try a quick bisect on CI replica node unless someone else wants it.
sam: if you need a fast local repro, note CI uses LANG=C.UTF-8. on my local mac it's en_US by default which might mask the issue. try exporting LANG=C.UTF-8 before running tests.
alex: hmm good point — on linux container the fallback for plural rules might differ. quick patch idea: in test wrap with locale context to assert deterministic behavior. e.g.
```python
with set_locale('en_US.UTF-8'):
    assert pluralize(2) == '2 items'
```
but we should also fix the underlying helper to not depend on global locale default.
marta: i can open a small fix PR to the branch that pins locale in the test and adds a comment referencing the upstream intl change. would that be acceptable as a stopgap?
priya: yeah open the PR to the feature branch (not main) so we can get CI green, then follow up with a proper helper fix in a separate change. add a test-case for C locale too.
sam: filing PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/4321 — includes test pin + comment. kicked off CI on the PR.
ci-bot: PR 4321 - build 9901 queued. running tests...
ci-bot: PR 4321 - build 9901 completed ✅. all tests passed on shards.
marta: awesome, thanks @sam and everyone :tada: merging fix to feature/localize-strings now. i'll watch post-merge smoke for a couple hours. if anything pops up we'll revert and follow up with the helper-level fix.
